_comment: TAX YEAR 2026 — the certification target. CRA distributes test returns in
mid-November, so this is the pack that must be right.
Verification pass of 2026-08-16: brackets, indexed credit amounts, CWB bands
and the CPP and EI figures all checked against CRA sources. Every estimate
and placeholder in those groups has been replaced with a published figure.
What remains unverified is statutory rather than indexed — CCA rates, the
first-year (AccII) adjustment, the fixed child care limits, the RRSP dollar
limit and the passenger vehicle cost limit. Each needs its own source.

cpp_max_contribution.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA announcement of maximum pensionable earnings and contributions for 2026. CORRECTED: placeholder was 4034.10. Cross-checks: (74,600 - 3,500) x 5.95% = 4,230.45.

cpp2_max_contribution.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA announcement of maximum pensionable earnings and contributions for 2026. CORRECTED: placeholder was 396.00. Cross-checks: (85,000 YAMPE - 74,600) x 4% = 416.00.

ei_max_premium.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against Canada Employment Insurance Commission, 2026 EI premium rate announcement. CORRECTED: placeholder was 1077.48. Cross-checks: 68,900 MIE x 1.63% = 1,123.07.

ei_min_insurable.source: Review heuristic only, never used in a calculation.

cca_rate_class8.source: CCA rate, class 8 — furniture, fixtures and general equipment. Declining balance. Statutory, not indexed.

cca_rate_class10.source: CCA rate, class 10 — most motor vehicles. Declining balance. Class 10.1 passenger vehicles above the cost limit are NOT modelled and are treated differently.

cca_rate_class12.source: CCA rate, class 12 — tools under the cost threshold, computer software. Written off in full, subject to the first-year rule.

cca_rate_class50.source: CCA rate, class 50 — computer hardware and systems software. Declining balance.

cca_first_year_adjustment.source: The classic half-year rule: only half of net additions enter the base in the year of acquisition, so the adjustment is negative. CONFIRM whether the Accelerated Investment Incentive applies for this tax year — under AccII the sign flips to +0.5 (a 1.5x first-year base) for eligible property. Getting this wrong misstates every first-year claim.

vehicle_cost_limit.source: PLACEHOLDER — 2025 limit carried over. The 2026 passenger vehicle cost limit is announced separately.

cca_rate_class10_1.source: CCA rate, class 10.1 — passenger vehicles above the cost limit. Same rate as class 10, but each vehicle is its own pool and neither recapture nor a terminal loss ever arises.
